{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Identify and remove the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
qa_mask = sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99
print("Number of QA orders to remove:", qa_mask.sum())

# Remove QA orders
sales_clean = sales[~qa_mask].copy()

# Verify the removal
print("New shape after removing QA orders:", sales_clean.shape)

# Confirm that no revenue is 999999.99 anymore
print("Any revenue still 999999.99?", (sales_clean['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).any())"}
